Definition

A forecast report is an automated analytics output that projects future cloud or SaaS usage and costs based on current consumption trends and predictive modeling.

Operational example

Forecast reports enable organizations to predict cloud expenditure and resource usage for upcoming quarters, aiding in financial and capacity planning.
